messages:
alex_support: Hey team, customer reported refund requests are being routed to the loyalty credit tool instead of the refund tool. example payload and logs below — urgent, customer is blocked :worried:
customer_jane: Payload we sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "user_id": "acct_123",
  "amount_cents": 5000,
  "currency": "USD",
  "reason": "product_return",
  "method": "card"
}
```
customer_jane: The API returned success but action taken was ISSUE_STORE_CREDIT (customer got store credit). We expected PROCESS_REFUND.
alex_support: Repro steps please? which endpoint, body, headers?
customer_jane: POST /v1/call_tool with body above, header Authorization: Bearer <key>. Happens intermittently ~2/10 requests.
maria_engineer: Looking at dispatch logs, the autorouter matched tool_choice: issue_store_credit with model_confidence 0.42 and fallback_score 0.33. It looks like the selector favored tools that accept an integer amount field named "amount_cents" vs our refund tool signature expecting "amount" or "total_amount_cents".
maria_engineer: Dispatch snippet:
```
MATCH_INPUT_KEYS: ["user_id","amount_cents","currency","reason","method"]
CANDIDATES: [issue_store_credit(signature: amount_cents:int), process_refund(signature: amount:float, currency:str)]
MODEL_OUTPUT: issue_store_credit
SCORES: {issue_store_credit:0.42, process_refund:0.33}
```

maria_engineer: So two issues: 1) our tool signature registry allowed a cheap signature match for issue_store_credit via amount_cents int, 2) selector doesn't penalize semantic mismatch (refund_reason present).
sam_sre: Any errors or latency in the trace?
maria_engineer: No errors; action executed fine. Repro script attached by me locally (ran 20 requests): 4 misroutes. Script uses same body as customer.
```
for i in range(20):
  resp = post('/v1/call_tool', json=payload)
  log(resp.json())
```

alex_support: Workaround for customer?
maria_engineer: For now set header X-tool-override: process_refund or include explicit "tool_hint":"process_refund" in the body. That will force the correct tool.

sam_sre: Are there billing implications? store credit issued vs chargeback refund is different. We should escalate billing ops. :warning:

maria_engineer: I'll open a quick PR to change matching precedence: prefer tools with "refund" in semantic keys if payload.reason includes refund-like values (refund, return, chargeback). Also will tighten signature matches so amount vs amount_cents mismatch is not a perfect match.

deploy-bot: deploy started: branch fix/dispatch-refund-priority -> canary

deploy-bot: deploy success: canary at 10% traffic

maria_engineer: Canary looks good after ~200 calls, 0 misroutes in canary. Increasing rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout complete to prod

alex_support: Sent workaround steps to customer and refunded the 3 affected accounts manually. Customer confirmed fix on their side. :thumbsup:

alex_support: Closing thread once billing ops confirms adjustments done.
